title: Meta’s Adam Mosseri says AI token budgets could soon be capped per engineer
slides: Why would Meta cap your AI token budget?
Engineers currently enjoy unlimited AI usage.
Adam Mosseri warns budgets may shrink soon.
You'll need to prioritize queries over experiments.
Start auditing your token use today.
thread_text:
1. Budget caps are coming.

Meta is preparing to limit AI tokens per engineer. The default today is unlimited — that changes soon.

2. Who decides your limit?

Adam Mosseri publicly warned that token budgets will shrink. Not a rumor — an internal signal.

3. Experiments vs. queries.

You’ll have to choose: run a new test or get an answer. Both cost tokens now.

4. The audit trap.

Most engineers haven’t tracked token use. Without data, you can’t defend your spend.

5. Check your dashboard.

Open your AI usage panel today. How many tokens did you burn last week?
